summary.headline: Jupiter Occultation in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the occultation of Jupiter in Taurus through Pisces, assigning political, royal, military, weather, and disease omens to the first, second, and third thirds of each sign. The next section begins with judgments for the occultation of Mars in each sign.
